title: HDDHub arm rotation constraints, square platter rendering, and centered tangent glow ring

requirements.summary: Constrain HDDHub arm downward rotation to ~30° max while remapping all 13 lanes into the reduced range without changing hover/click behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: When hovering across all 13 categories, the arm rotates smoothly but never exceeds the specified downward limit (~30° downward from the intended neutral/horizontal reference in the current visualization).
All 13 categories still map to distinct, visually separated lanes/arm positions within the reduced rotation range.
No other interactions change: hover still does not open the modal; click still opens the modal and sets selected lane state.

file_operations.description: Replace the current 20°–70° lane-to-rotation mapping with a clamped/normalized mapping that caps maximum downward rotation at ~30° (relative to the component’s visual neutral) and distributes all 13 lane angles evenly within the new [min,max] rotation range; keep activeCategoryId precedence (hover over selected) and do not alter any click/hover contract.

requirements.summary: Ensure disk.png renders as a true square platter at all sizes and spins around its visual center without distortion or wobble.
acceptanceCriteria: The rendered platter region for disk.png maintains a 1:1 aspect ratio at all responsive sizes (no oval/distortion).
The platter spin animation rotates around the visual center of disk.png (no wobble or off-axis rotation).
The platter remains correctly layered above bodyhdd.png and below arm.png.

file_operations.description: Refactor the platter layer so its layout box remains 1:1 (use an aspect-square wrapper with a single controlling dimension rather than height/width percentages tied to a non-square parent caused by top offsets), and keep transformOrigin centered on the square wrapper to prevent wobble; preserve existing z-order so disk.png stays above bodyhdd.png and below arm.png.

requirements.summary: Center the HDDHub glow ring on the disk.png center axis and keep it continuously tangent to the arm tip during lane transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: With any hovered/selected category, the glow ring’s center aligns to the disk.png visual center (coaxial with the platter), not drifting relative to the platter as lanes change.
As the arm moves between lanes, the glow ring stays tangent/in contact with the arm head tip continuously (including mid-transition), without appearing to move independently of the arm tip.
The glow ring remains within the visible HDD/platter area and does not appear oversized or out-of-bounds relative to disk.png.

file_operations.description: Rework glow ring geometry so its center is anchored to the computed disk.png center (in the hub container coordinate space) and its radius is derived from the arm-tip-to-disk-center distance (with a small calibrated tip offset if needed to match the actual arm.png head), ensuring tangency across continuous transitions; clamp ring radius to remain within the visible platter area of disk.png and remove any lane-based ring positioning that causes the ring center to drift between lanes.
